title: The router arm of the agent benchmark now revalidates stale sources live, so its times are not comparable with earlier rows
goal: agent_bench's router arm calls kb_ask.plan with revalidation off (revalidate=False or KB_NO_REVALIDATE=1) unless a flag asks for it, so its recorded wall times measure the router as before ST-jqwqdj2g made kb_ask.plan revalidate stale sources by default (up to 90 s per question); the repro (agent_bench.route with kb_ask.plan stubbed) exits 0 once the call passes revalidate=False or sets KB_NO_REVALIDATE. SP-etslk6yu review.

run: import sys,os; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); os.environ.pop('KB_NO_REVALIDATE',None); import agent_bench, kb_ask; seen={}; kb_ask.tool_answer=lambda q: None; kb_ask.plan=lambda q, model=None, revalidate='stale': (seen.update(r=revalidate, e=os.environ.get('KB_NO_REVALIDATE')) or {'kind':'web'}); kb_ask.web_prompt=lambda q, p: ''; agent_bench._step=lambda *a, **k: {}; agent_bench.route('What is x?'); print(seen); sys.exit(0 if (seen['r'] is False or seen['e']=='1') else 1)

the repro (agent_bench.route with kb_ask.plan stubbed) exits 0 once the call passes revalidate=False or sets KB_NO_REVALIDATE. SP-etslk6yu review

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 5 of 19, "Benchmark measurement: percentiles, a comparable router arm, a spend cap that holds and a corrected report"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise: agent_bench.route(q) calls kb_ask.plan(q) with revalidate left at its default "stale". Run at planning on main with kb_ask.plan stubbed: revalidate='stale', KB_NO_REVALIDATE unset, exit 1. bench_pool.router_run runs agent_bench.py --route, so the pool's router arm follows the same default; tools.md:23 names --route and needs the flag's line.
